en.label: Latest
en.title: Privacy, license, and compliance notices
changes: Added a License & Notices entry in the app tray and bundled LICENSE and NOTICE inside the app.
Added a website privacy policy and bottom privacy choices notice.
Clarified that website and product showcase images are AI-generated illustrative assets.
Removed competitor SEO positioning and added Apple, GitHub, and related trademark attribution.
Upgraded website dependencies and reduced both production and full npm audit vulnerability counts to 0.
The app, Sparkle update ZIP, and manual-install DMG are signed and notarized by Apple.
